name: Enchantment Resort
positioning: Southwestern casita resort at the base of Boynton Canyon in Sedona, with a Trail House for guided hikes, rides and canyon adventures
best_for: Travelers who want hiking, mountain biking and guided outdoor adventures from the resort
Families with children of all ages
Couples wanting a casita with a private deck or patio and spa access at Mii amo

facts.text: The casitas and suites sit at the base of Boynton Canyon.
The resort is surrounded by acres of wilderness.
The casitas are set in adobe, pueblo-style buildings.
Each casita is designed in a Southwestern motif inspired by Sedona's landscapes.
Rooms have elegant furnishings and authentic Southwestern appointments.
One-bedroom suites have a living room with wood-beamed ceilings and a beehive fireplace.
Guests have access to over 400 miles of trails, and Trail House helps them choose hikes.
Complimentary stargazing with the resort astronomer is offered every Tuesday and Saturday evening, weather permitting.
Private Grand Canyon tours with Trail House guides include breakfast and a guided tour along the South Rim.
Premium mountain bikes and e-bikes can be rented during daylight hours.
Enchantment guests may attend the twice-daily Mii amo Crystal Grotto rituals.
At Camp Coyote, trained counselors lead kids in activities like nature walks and painting.

highlights.text: The resort is on the ancestral land of the Yavapai Tribe, in the Boynton Canyon vortex.
All rooms have a private deck or patio overlooking the canyon.
Each Pool Suite has a private pool, a viewing deck and an outdoor patio.
Trail House is the hub for outdoor adventures, with guided tours, professional-grade equipment rentals and a retail shop.
Guests have exclusive access to spa services at the sister property Mii amo, located steps from the resort.

considerations.text: Because the resort sits at the bottom of Boynton Canyon, there is no walkable neighborhood nearby.
Mii amo access for Enchantment guests is for ages 16 and up.
The resort is transforming its dining experiences, with new dining concepts planned for 2027.
